bill.title: Lunar Landing Day Act
bill.latestActionText: Introduced in the Senate, read twice, considered, read the third time, and passed without amendment by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S4273-4274; text: CR S4273-4274)

classification.plainSummary: This bill would designate July 20 as 'Lunar Landing Day' to commemorate the anniversary of the Apollo 11 moon landing in 1969. It is a ceremonial resolution that creates a symbolic observance without imposing new obligations, costs, or regulatory changes on any sector.

plain.whatItDoes: No one has written a summary of this bill yet. All we have is its title, and a title is not a description of a law. To find out what it does, you have to open the bill itself.
plain.whoItTouches: We cannot tell from the labels on this bill who it reaches. The subject is too broad to say.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing has changed yet. The title alone does not say what would change for you, and this tool will not guess. Most bills never become law.
